name: Cellar Floor Hatch v2 - Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Original low-poly concept vs scale-locked custom-topology floor architecture
review_note: The reworked Blender form preserves the flush one-tile opening, true dark shaft, short emerging rails, descending rungs, six hand-cut lid planks and restrained ironwork. The more upright lid is an intentional gameplay-camera change: its pale underside, twin forged bands and pegged rim now read instantly instead of collapsing into a small black grate.
improve: Verify the upright lid remains behind the opening and the fitted black shaft stays grass-free in the live Workyard camera.
